77200.commentary: (THIa) sīt'uṇhena ca ḍayhantī'ti vasanageh'ābhāvato sītena ca uṇhena ca pīḷiyamānā.

77204.meaning1: advice of the nun; lady's instruction

peto manussarūpena, saṃsaranto gamissati, yath'āgato tathā gato, kā tattha paridevanā.

77208.meaning1: as one has arrived; in the way one has come

examples.text: peto manussarūpena, saṃsaranto gamissati, yath'āgato tathā gato, kā tattha paridevanā.

77209.meaning1: with dishevelled hair; with unkempt hair

examples.text: puttasoken'ahaṃ aṭṭā, khittacittā visaññinī, naggā pakiṇṇakesī ca, tena tena vicāri'haṃ.

77211.commentary: (THIa) tena tenā'ti gāmena gāmaṃ nagarena nagaraṃ vīthiyā vīthiṃ vicariṃ ahaṃ.

examples.text: puttasoken'ahaṃ aṭṭā, khittacittā visaññinī, naggā pakiṇṇakesī ca, tena tena vicāri'haṃ.

77212.meaning1: afflicted with hunger and thirst; stricken by hunger and thirst

examples.text: vīthi saṅkārakūṭesu, susāne rathiyāsu ca, acariṃ tīṇi vassāni, khuppipāsāsamappitā.

77213.meaning1: having regained; having recovered; having got back
77213.commentary: (THIa) sacittaṃ paṭiladdhānā'ti buddh'ānubhāvena ummādaṃ pahāya attano pakaticittaṃ paṭilabhitvā.

77214.meaning1: having bowed; having paid respect; having honoured

examples.text: sacittaṃ paṭiladdhāna, vanditvāna upāvisiṃ, so me dhammam'adesesi, anukampāya gotamo.
disvāna lokapajjotaṃ, vanditvāna upāvisiṃ, so me dhammam'adesesi, anukampāya cakkhumā.

77215.meaning1: adorned with all jewellery; dripping in bling

examples.text: alaṅ'katā suvasanā, mālinī candan'okkhitā, sabb'ābharaṇasañchannā, dāsīgaṇapurakkhatā.
alaṅ'katā suvasanā, mālinī candan'okkhitā, sabb'ābharaṇasañchannā, dāsīgaṇapurakkhatā.

77217.meaning1: light-source of the world; epithet of the Buddha

examples.text: disvāna lokapajjotaṃ, vanditvāna upāvisiṃ, so me dhammam'adesesi, anukampāya cakkhumā.
sutvā ca kho mahesissa, saccaṃ sampaṭivijjh'ahaṃ, tatth'eva virajaṃ dhammaṃ, phusayiṃ amataṃ padaṃ.

tato kesāni chetvāna, pabbajiṃ anagāriyaṃ, ajja me sattamī ratti, yato taṇhā visositā'ti.

77225.meaning1: supreme being; best of all beings

examples.text: buddha vīra namo ty'atthu, sabbasattānam'uttama, yo maṃ dukkhā pamocesi, aññañ'ca bahukaṃ janaṃ.

77226.meaning1: cause of craving; (or) craving and its cause

asokaṃ virajaṃ khemaṃ, ariy'aṭṭh'aṅgikaṃ ujuṃ, taṃ maggaṃ anugacchāmi, yena tiṇṇā mah'esino.

77228.meaning1: afflicted by illness and death; hurt by sickness and dying

examples.text: bahūnaṃ vata atthāya, māyā janayi gotamaṃ, byādhimaraṇatunnānaṃ, dukkhakkhandhaṃ byapānudī'ti.

77229.meaning1: having given up; having abandoned; having let go (of)
77229.synonym: cajitvā, cajitvāna, nissajjitvā, pajahitvā, pariccajitvā, pahatvāna, pahantvāna, vijahitvā, visajjetvā, vissajjetvā, vosajjitvā, vossajjitvā

examples.text: saṃyojanāni etāni, pajahitvāna bhikkhunī, orambhā'gamanīyāni, na'y'idaṃ punarehisi.

77230.commentary: (THIa) paṭācārānusāsanin'ti paṭācārāya theriyā anusiṭṭhiṃ. paṭācārāya sāsanan'ti'pi vā pāṭho.

examples.text: tass'āhaṃ vacanaṃ sutvā, paṭācār'ānusāsaniṃ, pāde pakkhālayitvāna, ekam'ante upāvisiṃ.

77231.meaning1: hardship of beating and binding; pain of punishment and imprisonment
77231.commentary: (THIa) vadhabandhapariklesaṃ, jāto dukkhaṃ nigacchatī'ti. jīvitaviyojana-muṭṭhippahār'ādi-saṅkhātaṃ vadhapariklesañ'c'eva andubandhan'ādisaṅkhātaṃ bandhapariklesaṃ aññañ'ca yaṃkiñci dukkhaṃ nāma taṃ sabbaṃ jāto eva nigacchati, na ajāto, tasmā jātiṃ na rocemī'ti.

examples.text: jātassa maraṇaṃ hoti, hatthapādāna chedanaṃ, vadhabandhapariklesaṃ, jāto dukkhaṃ nigacchati.

77233.construction:
na > a + √bhī > bhay + *a + ā
abhaya + ā
77233.notes: Therīgāthā verses 35-36 (TH2.9, TH27) are attributed to her.

examples.text: abhaye bhiduro kāyo, yattha satā puthujjanā, nikkhipissām'imaṃ dehaṃ, sampajānā satīmatī.
itthaṃ sudaṃ abhayā therī gāthaṃ abhāsitthā'ti.

77234.notes: Therīgāthā verses 33-34 (TH2.8, TH26) are attributed to her.

examples.text: itthaṃ sudaṃ abhayamātu therī gāthaṃ abhāsitthā'ti.

77235.notes: Therīgāthā verse 19 (TH2.1, TH19) is attributed to her.

examples.text: itthaṃ sudaṃ bhagavā abhirūpanandaṃ sikkhamānaṃ imāhi gāthāhi abhiṇhaṃ ovadatī'ti.

77236.commentary: (VINa) aḍḍhakāsiyan'ti ettha kāsī'ti sahassaṃ vuccati taṃ agghanako kāsiyo. ayaṃ pana pañcasatāni agghati, tasmā aḍḍhakāsiyo'ti vutto. ten'ev'āha, upaḍḍhakāsīnaṃ khamamānan'ti. (THIa) nāmena aḍḍhakāsī nāma. (THIa) tattha yebhuyyena manussā sahassaṃ dātuṃ asakkontā tato upaḍḍhaṃ datvā divasabhāgameva ramitvā gacchanti, tesaṃ vasenāyaṃ aḍḍhakāsī'ti paññāyittha.
77236.notes: Therīgāthā verses 25-26 (TH2.4, TH22) are attributed to her.

examples.text: itthaṃ sudaṃ aḍḍhakāsi therī gāthaṃ abhāsitthā'ti.

77237.notes: Therīgāthā verse 5 (TH1.5, TH5) is attributed to her.

77238.commentary: (THIa) tassā rūpasampattiyā anopamā'ti nāmaṃ ahosi. tassā vayappattakāle bahū seṭṭhiputtā rājamah'āmattā rājāno ca pitu dūtaṃ pāhesuṃ, attano dhītaraṃ anopamaṃ dehi, idañ'c'idañ'ca te dassāmā'ti. sā taṃ sutvā upanissayasampannatāya ghar'āvāsena mayhaṃ attho n'atthī'ti satthu santikaṃ gantvā dhammaṃ sutvā ñāṇassa paripākaṃ gatattā desan'ānusārena vipassanaṃ ārabhitvā taṃ ussukkāpentī maggapaṭipāṭiyā tatiyaphale patiṭṭhāsi.
77238.notes: Therīgāthā verses 151-156 (TH6.5, TH54) are attributed to her.

examples.text: patthitā rājaputtehi, seṭṭhiputtehi gijjhitā, pitu me pesayī dūtaṃ, detha mayhaṃ anopamaṃ.
yattakaṃ tulitā esā, tuyhaṃ dhītā anopamā, tato aṭṭhaguṇaṃ dassaṃ, hiraññaṃ ratanāni ca.

77239.notes: Therīgāthā verses 39-41 (TH3.1, TH29) are attributed to her.

77240.notes: Therīgāthā verses 45-47 (TH3.3, TH31) are attributed to her.

77241.meaning1: name of an arahant nun; great disciple of the Buddha; foremost nun in remembering previous lives; Bhaddā Kāpilānī
77241.commentary: (THIa) tath'eva bhaddākāpilānī'ti yathā mahākassapo etāhi yathāvuttāhi tīhi vijjāhi tevijjo maccuhāyī ca, tath'eva bhaddākāpilānī tevijjā maccuhāyinī'ti.
77241.notes: Therīgāthā verses 63-66 (TH4.1, TH37) are attributed to her.

examples.text: tath'eva bhaddākāpilānī, tevijjā maccuhāyinī, dhāreti antimaṃ dehaṃ, jitvā māraṃ savāhanaṃ.

77242.meaning1: name of an arahant nun; great disciple of the Buddha; foremost nun in quick realization; Bhaddā Kuṇḍalakesā
77242.commentary: (ANa) khipp'ābhiññānan'ti khipp'ābhiññānaṃ bhikkhunīnaṃ, bhaddā kuṇḍalakesā, aggā'ti dasseti. ayam'pi hi padum'uttarabuddhakāle haṃsavatiyaṃ kulagehe nibbattā satthu dhammakathaṃ sutvā satthāraṃ ekaṃ bhikkhuniṃ khipp'ābhiññānaṃ aggaṭṭhāne ṭhapentaṃ disvā adhikārakammaṃ katvā taṃ ṭhān'antaraṃ patthesi. sā kappasatasahassaṃ devamanussesu saṃsaritvā kassapabuddhakāle kikissa kāsirañño gehe sattannaṃ bhaginīnaṃ abbhantarā hutvā vīsati vassasahassāni dasa sīlāni samādāya komārikabrahmacariyaṃ carantī saṅghassa vasanapariveṇaṃ kāretvā ekaṃ buddhantaraṃ devamanussesu saṃsaritvā imasmiṃ buddh'uppāde rājagahanagare seṭṭhikule paṭisandhiṃ gaṇhi, bhaddā'ti'ssā nāmaṃ akaṃsu. (THIa) tato bhaddā cintesi, na sakkā mayā iminā niyāmena gehaṃ gantuṃ, ito'va gantvā ekaṃ pabbajjaṃ pabbajissāmī'ti nigaṇṭhārāmaṃ gantvā nigaṇṭhe pabbajjaṃ yāci. atha naṃ te āhaṃsu, kena niyāmena pabbajjā hotū'ti? yaṃ tumhākaṃ pabbajjāya uttamaṃ, tadeva karothā'ti. te sādhū'ti tassā tāl'aṭṭhinā kese luñcitvā pabbājesuṃ. puna kesā vaḍḍhantā kuṇḍalāvaṭṭā hutvā vaḍḍhesuṃ. tato paṭṭhāya sā kuṇḍalakesā'ti nāma jātā. sā tattha uggahetabbaṃ samayaṃ vādamaggañ'ca uggahetvā ettakaṃ nāma ime jānanti, ito uttari viseso n'atthī'ti ñatvā tato apakkamitvā yattha yattha paṇḍitā atthi, tattha tattha gantvā tesaṃ jānanasippaṃ uggahetvā attanā saddhiṃ kathetuṃ samatthaṃ adisvā yaṃ yaṃ gāmaṃ vā nigamaṃ vā pavisati, tassa dvāre vālukārāsiṃ katvā tattha jambusākhaṃ ṭhapetvā yo mama vādaṃ āropetuṃ sakkoti, so imaṃ sākhaṃ maddatū'ti samīpe ṭhitadārakānaṃ saññaṃ datvā vasanaṭṭhānaṃ gacchati. satt'āham'pi jambusākhāya tath'eva ṭhitāya taṃ gahetvā pakkamati.
77242.notes: Therīgāthā verses 107-111 (TH5.9, TH46) are attributed to her.

examples.text: tassa dhammesu dāy'ādā, orasā dhammanimmitā, bhaddākuṇḍalakesā'ti, hessati satthu sāvikā.

77243.commentary: (THIa) bhadre'ti taṃ ālapati. bhadraratā'ti bhadresu sīl'ādidhammesu ratā abhiratā hohi.
77243.notes: Therīgāthā verse 9 (TH1.9, TH9) is attributed to her.

examples.text: saddhāya pabbajitvāna, bhadre bhadraratā bhava, bhāvehi kusale dhamme, yogakkhem'amanuttaran'ti.

77244.notes: Therīgāthā verses 122-126 (TH5.12, TH49) are attributed to her.

examples.text: itthaṃ sudaṃ candā therī gāthaṃ abhāsitthā'ti.

77245.commentary: (THIa) ayam'pi purimabuddhesu kat'ādhikārā tattha tattha bhave vivaṭṭ'ūpanissayaṃ kusalaṃ upacinantī, anukkamena upacitakusalamūlā sambhatavimokkhasambhārā hutvā imasmiṃ buddh'uppāde vaṅgahārajanapade aññatarasmiṃ migaluddakagāme jeṭṭhakamigaluddakassa dhītā hutvā nibbatti, cāpā'ti'ssā nāmaṃ ahosi. (THIa) cāpā puttam'atosayī'ti migaluddassa dhītā cāpā ājīvakassa puttā'ti-ādinā maṃ ghaṭṭentī puttaṃ tosesi keḷāyasi.
77245.notes: Therīgāthā verses 292-312 (TH13.3, TH68) are attributed to her.

examples.text: sumattaṃ maṃ maññamānā, cāpā puttam'atosayi, cāpāya bandhanaṃ chetvā, pabbajissaṃ puno'p'ahaṃ.
tassa pādāni vanditvā, katvāna naṃ padakkhiṇaṃ, cāpāya ādisitvāna, pabbajiṃ anagāriyaṃ, tisso vijjā anuppattā, kataṃ buddhassa sāsanaṃ.

77246.notes: Therīgāthā verses 27-28 (TH2.5, TH23) are attributed to her.

examples.text: itthaṃ sudaṃ cittā therī gāthaṃ abhāsitthā'ti.

77247.notes: Therīgāthā verses 48-50 (TH3.4, TH32) are attributed to her.

examples.text: itthaṃ sudaṃ dantikā therī gāthaṃ abhāsitthā'ti.

examples.text: itthaṃ sudaṃ dhammā therī gāthaṃ abhāsitthā'ti.

examples.text: dhīre nirodhaṃ phusehi, saññāvūpasamaṃ sukhaṃ, ārādhayāhi nibbānaṃ, yogakkhem'amanuttaran'ti.

77250.meaningLit: belonging to the Gotama family clan
77250.commentary: (THIa) gotamī'ti'ssā nāmaṃ ahosi. kisasarīratāya pana kisāgotamī'ti voharīyittha. taṃ patikulaṃ gataṃ duggatakulassa dhītā'ti paribhaviṃsu. sā ekaṃ puttaṃ vijāyi.
77250.notes: Therīgāthā verses 213-223 (TH10.1, TH63) are attributed to her.

examples.text: aham'amhi kantasallā, ohitabhārā katañ'hi karaṇīyaṃ, kisā gotamī therī, vimuttacittā imaṃ bhaṇī'ti.
itthaṃ sudaṃ kisā gotamī therī gāthaṃ abhāsitthā'ti.

77251.commentary: (THIa) ayam'pi purimabuddhesu kat'ādhikārā tattha tattha bhave vivaṭṭ'ūpanissayaṃ kusalaṃ upacinantī anukkamena sambhatavimokkhasambhārā hutvā, paripakkakusalamūlā sugatīsu'y'eva saṃsarantī imasmiṃ buddh'uppāde sāvatthiyaṃ brāhmaṇakule nibbattā, guttā'ti'ssā nāmaṃ ahosi. sā viññutaṃ patvā upanissayasampattiyā codiyamānā ghar'āvāsaṃ jigucchantī mātāpitaro anujānāpetvā mahāpajāpatigotamiyā santike pabbaji. pabbajitvā ca vipassanaṃ paṭṭhapetvā bhāvanaṃ anuyuñjantiyā tassā cittaṃ cirakālaparicayena bahiddh'ārammaṇe vidhāvati, ek'aggaṃ n'āhosi.

examples.text: gutte yadatthaṃ pabbajjā, hitvā puttaṃ vasuṃ piyaṃ, tam'eva anubrūhehi, mā cittassa vasaṃ gami.
itthaṃ sudaṃ guttā therī gāthaṃ abhāsitthā'ti.

examples.text: itthaṃ sudaṃ jentā therī gāthāyo abhāsitthā'ti.

examples.text: itthaṃ sudaṃ mittā kāḷī therī gāthaṃ abhāsitthā'ti.

77255.meaning1: smith's daughter; epithet of Subhā Therī
77255.notes: Therīgāthā verses 339-367 (TH13.5, TH70) are attributed to her.

77257.meaning1: name of an arahant nun; great disciple of the Buddha; foremost nun in great wisdom

77258.notes: Therīgāthā verses 107-111 (TH5.9, TH46) are attributed to her.

examples.text: itthaṃ sudaṃ bhaddā kuṇḍalakesā therī gāthaṃ abhāsitthā'ti.

77259.notes: Therīgāthā verses 29-30 (TH2.6, TH24) are attributed to her.

examples.text: itthaṃ sudaṃ mettikā therī gāthaṃ abhāsitthā'ti.

77260.commentary: (THIa) mitte'ti taṃ ālapati. mittaratā'ti kalyāṇamittesu abhiratā. tattha sakkārasammānakaraṇatā hohi.
77260.notes: Therīgāthā verse 8 (TH1.8, TH8) is attributed to her.

examples.text: saddhāya pabbajitvāna, mitte mittaratā bhava, bhāvehi kusale dhamme, yogakkhemassa pattiyā'ti.

examples.text: itthaṃ sudaṃ mittā therī gāthaṃ abhāsitthā'ti.

77262.notes: Therīgāthā verses 92-96 (TH5.6, TH43) are attributed to her.

77263.commentary: (THIa) sā tena puññakammena devaloke nibbattitvā apar'āparaṃ sugatīsu'y'eva saṃsarantī imasmiṃ buddh'uppāde sāvatthiyaṃ brāhmaṇamahāsālakule nibbatti, muttā'tissā nāmaṃ ahosi. sā upanissayasampannatāya vīsativassakāle mahāpajāpatigotamiyā santike pabbajitvā sikkhamānāva hutvā kammaṭṭhānaṃ kathāpetvā vipassanāya kammaṃ karoti. sā ekadivasaṃ bhattakiccaṃ katvā piṇḍapātapaṭikkantā therīnaṃ bhikkhunīnaṃ vattaṃ dassetvā divāṭṭhānaṃ gantvā raho nisinnā vipassanāya manasikāraṃ ārabhi. satthā surabhigandhakuṭiyā nisinno'va obhāsaṃ vissajjetvā tassā purato nisinno viya attānaṃ dassetvā mutte muccassu yogehī'ti imaṃ gātham'āha.
77263.notes: Therīgāthā verse 2 (TH1.2, TH2) is attributed to her.

examples.text: mutte muccassu yogehi, cando rāhuggahā iva, vippamuttena cittena, anaṇā bhuñja piṇḍakan'ti.
itthaṃ sudaṃ bhagavā muttaṃ sikkhamānaṃ imāya gāthāya abhiṇhaṃ ovadatī'ti.

77264.notes: Therīgāthā verse 11 (TH1.11, TH11) is attributed to her.

examples.text: itthaṃ sudaṃ muttā therī gāthaṃ abhāsitthā'ti.

77265.notes: Therīgāthā verses 87-91 (TH5.5, TH42) are attributed to her.

examples.text: itthaṃ sudaṃ nand'uttarā therī gāthaṃ abhāsitthā'ti.

77266.meaning1: group of five hundred arahant nuns
77266.notes: Therīgāthā verses 127-132 (TH6.1, TH50) are attributed to them.

examples.text: itthaṃ sudaṃ pañcasatamattā therī bhikkhuniyo paṭācārāya santike aññaṃ byākariṃsū'ti.

77267.commentary: (THIa) puṇṇā'ti'ssā nāmaṃ ahosi. sā upanissayasampannatāya vīsativassāni vasamānā mahāpajāpatigotamiyā santike dhammaṃ sutvā paṭiladdhasaddhā pabbajitvā sikkhamānā eva hutvā vipassanaṃ ārabhi.
77267.notes: Therīgāthā verse 3 (TH1.3, TH3) is attributed to her.

examples.text: puṇṇe pūrassu dhammehi, cando pannarase'r'iva, paripuṇṇāya paññāya, tamokhandhaṃ padālayā'ti.
itthaṃ sudaṃ puṇṇā therī gāthaṃ abhāsitthā'ti.

77268.commentary: (THIa) mānopanissayavasena kammassa katattā imasmiṃ buddh'uppāde anāthapiṇḍikassa seṭṭhino gharadāsiyā kucchimhi nibbatti, puṇṇā'ti'ssā nāmaṃ ahosi. sā sīhanādasutt'antadesanāya (ma. ni. 1.146 ādayo) sot'āpannā hutvā pacchā udakasuddhikaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ dametvā seṭṭhinā sambhāvitā hutvā tena bhujissabhāvaṃ pāpitā taṃ pabbajjaṃ anujānāpetvā pabbajitvā vipassanāya kammaṃ karontī na cirass'eva saha paṭisambhidāhi arahattaṃ pāpuṇi. tena vuttaṃ apadāne.
77268.notes: Therīgāthā verses 236-251 (TH12.1, TH65) are attributed to her.

examples.text: itthaṃ sudaṃ puṇṇā therī gāthaṃ abhāsitthā'ti.

77269.commentary: (THIa) sā tena puññakammena devamanussesu saṃsarantī anukkamena upacitavimokkhasambhārā hutvā imasmiṃ buddh'uppāde vesāliyaṃ mahāvibhavassa brāhmaṇassa gehe nibbattitvā rohinī'ti laddhanāmā viññutaṃ patvā, satthari vesāliyaṃ viharante vihāraṃ gantavā dhammaṃ sutvā sot'āpannā hutvā mātāpitūnaṃ dhammaṃ desetvā sāsane pasādaṃ uppādetvā te anujānāpetvā sayaṃ pabbajitvā vipassanāya kammaṃ karontī na cirass'eva saha paṭisambhidāhi arahattaṃ pāpuṇi. (THIa) rohinī dāni pucchāmī'ti, amma rohini, taṃ ahaṃ idāni pucchāmī'ti brāhmaṇo attano dhītaraṃ pucchanto āha.
77269.notes: Therīgāthā verses 271-291 (TH13.2, TH67) are attributed to her.

examples.text: vipulaṃ annañ'ca pānañ'ca, samaṇānaṃ pavecchasi, rohinī dāni pucchāmi, kena te samaṇā piyā.
itthaṃ sudaṃ rohinī therī gāthaṃ abhāsitthā'ti.

77270.commentary: (THIa) ayam'pi purimabuddhesu kat'ādhikārā tattha tattha bhave vivaṭṭ'ūpanissayaṃ kusalaṃ upacinitvā sugatīsu'y'eva saṃsarantī imasmiṃ buddh'uppāde kosambiyaṃ gahapatimahāsālakule nibbattitvā sāmā'ti'ssā nāmaṃ ahosi. sā viññutaṃ pattā sāmāvatiyā upāsikāya piyasahāyikā hutvā tāya kālaṅ'katāya sañjātasaṃvegā pabbaji. pabbajitvā ca sāmāvatikaṃ ārabbha uppannasokaṃ vinodetuṃ asakkontī ariyamaggaṃ gaṇhituṃ n'āsakkhi. aparabhāge āsanasālāya nisinnassa ānandattherassa ovādaṃ sutvā vipassanaṃ paṭṭhapetvā tato sattame divase saha paṭisambhidāhi arahattaṃ pāpuṇi.
77270.notes: Therīgāthā verses 37-38 (TH2.10, TH28) are attributed to her.

examples.text: itthaṃ sudaṃ sāmā therī gāthaṃ abhāsitthā'ti.

77271.notes: Therīgāthā verses 39-41 (TH3.1, TH29) are attributed to her.

examples.text: itthaṃ sudaṃ aparā sāmā therī gāthaṃ abhāsitthā'ti.

77272.commentary: (THIa) hitvā ghare pabbajitvā'ti saṅghāya theriyā gāthā. tassā vatthu dhīrātheriyā vatthusadisaṃ.
77272.notes: Therīgāthā verse 18 (TH1.18, TH18) is attributed to her.

examples.text: itthaṃ sudaṃ saṅghā therī gāthaṃ abhāsitthā'ti.

77273.commentary: (THIa) tassā mātulassa nāmaṃ karomā'ti sīhā'ti nāmaṃ akaṃsu. sā viññutaṃ patvā ekadivasaṃ satthārā sīhassa senāpatino dhamme desiyamāne taṃ dhammaṃ sutvā paṭiladdhasaddhā mātāpitaro anujānāpetvā pabbaji. pabbajitvā ca vipassanaṃ ārabhitvāpi bahiddhā puthuttārammaṇe vidhāvantaṃ cittaṃ nivattetuṃ asakkontī satta saṃvaccharāni micchāvitakkehi bādhīyamānā citt'assādaṃ alabhantī kiṃ me iminā pāpajīvitena, ubbandhitvā marissāmī'ti pāsaṃ gahetvā rukkhasākhāyaṃ laggitvā taṃ attano kaṇṭhe paṭimuñcantī pubbāciṇṇavasena vipassanāya cittaṃ abhinīhari, antimabhavikatāya pāsassa bandhanaṃ gīvaṭṭhāne ahosi, ñāṇassa paripākaṃ gatattā sā tāva'd'eva vipassanaṃ vaḍḍhetvā saha paṭisambhidāhi arahattaṃ pāpuṇi. arahattaṃ pattasamakālam'eva ca pāsabandho gīvato muccitvā vinivatti.
77273.notes: Therīgāthā verses 77-81 (TH5.3, TH40) are attributed to her.

examples.text: itthaṃ sudaṃ sīhā therī gāthaṃ abhāsitthā'ti.

77274.meaning1: name of an arahant nun; great disciple of the Buddha; foremost nun in having energy aroused
77274.commentary: (ANa) āraddhavīriyānan'ti paggahitaparipuṇṇavīriyānaṃ soṇā aggā'ti dasseti. ayaṃ kira padum'uttarabuddhakāle haṃsavatīnagare kulagehe paṭisandhiṃ gahetvā aparabhāge dhammaṃ suṇantī satthāraṃ ekaṃ bhikkhuniṃ āraddhavīriyānaṃ aggaṭṭhāne ṭhapentaṃ disvā adhikārakammaṃ katvā taṃ ṭhān'antaraṃ patthesi. sā kappasatasahassaṃ devamanussesu saṃsaritvā imasmiṃ buddh'uppāde sāvatthiyaṃ kulagehe paṭisandhiṃ gahetvā aparabhāge ghar'āvāse vutthā bahū puttadhītaro labhitvā sabbe'pi visuṃ visuṃ ghar'āvāse patiṭṭhāpesi. te tato paṭṭhāya ayaṃ amhākaṃ kiṃ karissatī'ti taṃ attano santikaṃ āgataṃ mātā'ti saññam'pi na kariṃsu. bahuputtikasoṇā tesaṃ attani agāravabhāvaṃ ñatvā ghar'āvāsena kiṃ karissāmī'ti nikkhamitvā pabbaji. atha naṃ bhikkhuniyo ayaṃ vattaṃ na jānāti, ayuttaṃ karotī'ti daṇḍakammaṃ karonti. puttadhītaro taṃ daṇḍakammaṃ āharantiṃ disvā ayaṃ yāv'ajjadivasā sikkhāmattam'pi na jānātī'ti diṭṭhadiṭṭhaṭṭhāne uppaṇḍesuṃ. sā tesaṃ vacanaṃ sutvā uppannasaṃvegā attano gativisodhanaṃ kātuṃ vaṭṭatī'ti nisinnaṭṭhāne'pi ṭhitaṭṭhāne'pi dvattiṃsākāraṃ sajjhāyati. sā yath'eva pubbe bahuputtikasoṇattherī'ti paññāyittha, evaṃ pacchā āraddhavīriyasoṇattherī'ti pākaṭā jātā.
77274.notes: Therīgāthā verses 102-106 (TH5.8, TH45) are attributed to her.

examples.text: itthaṃ sudaṃ soṇā therī gāthaṃ abhāsitthā'ti.
etadaggaṃ, bhikkhave, mama sāvikānaṃ bhikkhunīnaṃ āraddhavīriyānaṃ yadidaṃ soṇā.

77275.meaningLit: beautiful woman living in Jīvaka's Mango Grove
77275.notes: Therīgāthā verses 368-401 (TH14.1, TH71) are attributed to her.

77276.notes: Therīgāthā verses 339-367 (TH13.5, TH70) are attributed to her.

77277.notes: Therīgāthā verses 145-150 (TH6.4, TH53) are attributed to her.

examples.text: itthaṃ sudaṃ sujātā therī gāthaṃ abhāsitthā'ti.

77278.commentary: (THIa) ye sukkaṃ na upāsanti, desentiṃ buddhasāsanan'ti buddhassa bhagavato sāsanaṃ yāthāvato desentiṃ pakāsentiṃ sukkaṃ theriṃ ye na upāsanti na payirupāsanti. te ime rājagahe manussā kiṃ katā'ti yojanā.
77278.notes: Therīgāthā verses 54-56 (TH3.6, TH34) are attributed to her.

examples.text: kiṃ'me katā rājagahe manussā, madhuṃ pītā'va acchare, ye sukkaṃ na upāsanti, desentiṃ buddhasāsanaṃ.
sukkā sukkehi dhammehi, vītarāgā samāhitā, dhāreti antimaṃ dehaṃ, jetvā māraṃ savāhanan'ti.

77279.notes: Therīgāthā verse 14 (TH1.14, TH14) is attributed to her.

examples.text: itthaṃ sudaṃ sumanā therī gāthaṃ abhāsitthā'ti.

77280.notes: Therīgāthā verse 16 (TH1.16, TH16) is attributed to her.

examples.text: itthaṃ sudaṃ sumanā vuḍḍhapabbajitā therī gāthaṃ abhāsitthā'ti.

77281.commentary: (THIa) tato paṭṭhāya sā sumaṅgalamātā'ti paññāyittha. yasmā pan'assā nāmagottaṃ na pākaṭaṃ, tasmā aññatarā therī bhikkhunī apaññātā'ti pāḷiyaṃ vuttaṃ. so'pi'ssā putto viññutaṃ patto pabbajitvā saha paṭisambhidāhi arahattaṃ patvā sumaṅgalatthero'ti pākaṭo ahosi.
77281.notes: Therīgāthā verses 23-24 (TH2.3, TH21) are attributed to her.

examples.text: itthaṃ sudaṃ sumaṅgalamātā therī gāthaṃ abhāsitthā'ti.

77282.commentary: (THIa) tassā mātāpitaro sumedhā'ti nāmaṃ akaṃsu. taṃ anukkamena vuddhippattavayappattakāle mātāpitaro vāraṇavatīnagare anikarattassa nāma rañño dassāmā'ti sammantesuṃ. sā pana daharakālato paṭṭhāya attano samānavayāhi rājakaññāhi dāsijanehi ca saddhiṃ bhikkhun'upassayaṃ gantvā bhikkhunīnaṃ santike dhammaṃ sutvā cirakālato paṭṭhāya kat'ādhikāratāya saṃsāre jātasaṃvegā sāsane abhippasannā hutvā vayappattakāle kāmehi vinivattitamānasā ahosi. tena sā mātāpitūnaṃ ñātīnaṃ sammantanaṃ sutvā na mayhaṃ ghar'āvāsena kiccaṃ, pabbajissām'ahan'ti āha.
77282.notes: Therīgāthā verses 450-524 (TH16.1, TH73) are attributed to her.

examples.text: mantāvatiyā nagare, rañño koñcassa aggamahesiyā, dhītā āsiṃ sumedhā, pasāditā sāsanakarehi.
itthaṃ sudaṃ sumedhā therī gāthāyo abhāsitthā'ti.

77284.notes: Therīgāthā verse 4 (TH1.4, TH4) is attributed to her.

examples.text: tisse sikkhassu sikkhāya, mā taṃ yogā upaccaguṃ, sabbayogavisaṃyuttā, cara loke anāsavā'ti.

77285.notes: Therīgāthā verse 5 (TH1.5, TH5) is attributed to her.

examples.text: tisse yuñjassu dhammehi, khaṇo taṃ mā upaccagā, khaṇ'ātītā hi socanti, nirayamhi samappitā'ti.
itthaṃ sudaṃ aññatarā tissā therī gāthaṃ abhāsitthā'ti.

77286.commentary: (THIa) sā tena puññakammena tāvatiṃsesu nibbattitvā tattha yāvat'āyukaṃ uḷāradibbasampattiṃ anubhavitvā tato cutā sugatīsu'y'eva saṃsarantī imasmiṃ buddh'uppāde sāvatthiyaṃ gahapatimahāsālakule nibbattitvā ubbirī'ti laddhanāmā abhirūpā dassanīyā pāsādikā ahosi. sā vayappattakāle kosalaraññā attano gehaṃ nītā, katipayasaṃvacchar'ātikkamena ekaṃ dhītaraṃ labhi. tassā jīvantī'ti nāmaṃ akaṃsu. rājā tassā dhītaraṃ disvā tuṭṭhamānaso ubbiriyā abhisekaṃ adāsi.
77286.notes: Therīgāthā verses 51-53 (TH3.5, TH33) are attributed to her.

examples.text: amma jīvā'ti vanamhi kandasi, attānaṃ adhigaccha ubbiri, cull'āsītisahassāni, sabbā jīvasanāmikā, etamh'āḷāhane daḍḍhā, tāsaṃ kam'anusocasi.
itthaṃ sudaṃ ubbirī therī gāthaṃ abhāsitthā'ti.

77287.notes: Therīgāthā verse 10 (TH1.10, TH10) is attributed to her.

examples.text: upasame tare oghaṃ, maccudheyyaṃ suduttaraṃ, dhārehi antimaṃ dehaṃ, jetvā māraṃ savāhanan'ti.

77288.notes: Therīgāthā verses 42-44 (TH3.2, TH30) are attributed to her.

examples.text: itthaṃ sudaṃ uttamā therī gāthaṃ abhāsitthā'ti.

77289.notes: Therīgāthā verses 45-47 (TH3.3, TH31) are attributed to her.

examples.text: itthaṃ sudaṃ aparā uttamā therī gāthaṃ abhāsitthā'ti.

77290.commentary: (THIa) ayam'pi purimabuddhesu kat'ādhikārā tattha tattha bhave vivaṭṭ'ūpanissayaṃ kusalaṃ upacinantī, anukkamena sambhāvitakusalamūlā samupacitavimokkhasambhārā paripakka-vimutti-paripācanīya-dhammā hutvā, imasmiṃ buddh'uppāde sāvatthiyaṃ aññatarasmiṃ kulagehe nibbattitvā uttarā'ti laddhanāmā anukkamena viññutaṃ patvā paṭācārāya theriyā santikaṃ upasaṅkami. therī tassā dhammaṃ kathesi. sā dhammaṃ sutvā saṃsāre jātasaṃvegā sāsane abhippasannā hutvā pabbaji. pabbajitvā ca katapubbakiccā paṭācārāya theriyā santike vipassanaṃ paṭṭhapetvā bhāvanam'anuyuñjantī upanissayasampannatāya indriyānaṃ paripākaṃ gatattā ca na cirass'eva vipassanaṃ ussukkāpetvā saha paṭisambhidāhi arahattaṃ pāpuṇi.
77290.notes: Therīgāthā verse 15 (TH1.15, TH15) is attributed to her.

examples.text: itthaṃ sudaṃ uttarā therī gāthaṃ abhāsitthā'ti.

77291.notes: Therīgāthā verses 175-181 (TH7.1, TH58) are attributed to her.

examples.text: itthaṃ sudaṃ uttarā therī gāthaṃ abhāsitthā'ti.

77292.commentary: (THIa) ayam'pi purimabuddhesu kat'ādhikārā tattha tattha bhave vivaṭṭ'ūpanissayaṃ kusalaṃ upacinantī, anukkamena sambhatavimokkhasambhārā hutvā imasmiṃ buddh'uppāde bhārukacchakanagare kulagehe nibbattitvā vayappattā patikulaṃ gatā ekaṃ puttaṃ vijāyi. tassa vaḍḍho'ti nāmaṃ ahosi. tato paṭṭhāya sā vaḍḍhamātā'ti voharīyittha.
77292.notes: Therīgāthā verses 204-212 (TH9.1, TH62) are attributed to her.

examples.text: itthaṃ sudaṃ vaḍḍhamātā therī gāthaṃ abhāsitthā'ti.

77293.notes: Therīgāthā verses 133-138 (TH6.2, TH51) are attributed to her.

examples.text: itthaṃ sudaṃ vāseṭṭhī therī gāthaṃ abhāsitthā'ti.

77294.commentary: (THIa) vimalā'ti'ssā nāmaṃ ahosi. sā vayappattā tath'eva jīvikaṃ kappentī ekadivasaṃ āyasmantaṃ mahāmoggallānaṃ vesāliyaṃ piṇḍāya carantaṃ disvā paṭibaddhacittā hutvā therassa vasanaṭṭhānaṃ gantvā theraṃ uddissa palobhanakammaṃ kātuṃ ārabhi. titthiyehi uyyojitā tathā akāsī'ti keci vadanti. thero tassā asubhavibhāvanamukhena santajjanaṃ katvā ovādam'adāsi.
77294.notes: Therīgāthā verses 72-76 (TH5.2, TH39) are attributed to her.

examples.text: itthaṃ sudaṃ vimalā purāṇagaṇikā therī gāthaṃ abhāsitthā'ti.

77295.commentary: (THIa) vīrā vīrehi dhammehī'ti vīriyapadhānatāya vīrehi tej'ussadehi ariyamaggadhammehi bhāvit'indriyā vaḍḍhitasaddh'ādiindriyā vīrā bhikkhunī vatthukāmehi savāhanaṃ kilesamāraṃ jinitvā āyatiṃ punabbhav'ābhāvato antimaṃ dehaṃ dhāretī'ti therī aññaṃ viya katvā attānaṃ dasseti.
77295.notes: Therīgāthā verse 7 (TH1.7, TH7) is attributed to her.

examples.text: vīrā vīrehi dhammehi, bhikkhunī bhāvit'indriyā, dhārehi antimaṃ dehaṃ, jetvā māraṃ savāhinin'ti.

77296.notes: Therīgāthā verse 13 (TH1.13, TH13) is attributed to her.

examples.text: itthaṃ sudaṃ visākhā therī gāthaṃ abhāsitthā'ti.

77297.meaningLit: Jasmin who oradined in old age
77297.notes: Therīgāthā verse 16 (TH1.16, TH16) is attributed to her.

77298.meaning1: sets (one's heart); directs (one's mind); forms (an intention)
77298.commentary: (THIa) tattha cittaṃ paṇīdhehī'ti tasmiṃ tāvatiṃsādike devanikāye tava cittaṃ ṭhapehi, upapajjanāya nikantiṃ karohi. cātumahārājikānaṃ bhogā itarehi nihīnā'ti adhippāyena tāvatiṃs'ādayova vuttā.

examples.text: tāvatiṃsā ca yāmā ca, tusitā c'āpi devatā, nimmānaratino devā, ye devā vasavattino, tattha cittaṃ paṇīdhehi, yattha te vusitaṃ pure.

77299.meaning1: wandering on to birth and death; flowing along to rebirth and dying
77299.commentary: (THIa) tato eva avītivattā sakkāyaṃ nissaraṇ'ābhimukhā ahutvā sakkāyatīram'eva anuparidhāvantā jātimaraṇasārino rāg'ādīhi anugatattā punappunaṃ jātimaraṇam'eva anussaranti, tato na vimuccantī'ti.

examples.text: kālaṃ kālaṃ bhav'ābhavaṃ, sakkāyasmiṃ purakkhatā, avītivattā sakkāyaṃ, jātimaraṇasārino.
